# zen-cleaner — AI Discovery Index

> Declarative Kubernetes cleanup controller. Define `ZenCleanerPolicy` objects (API group `cleaner.zen-mesh.io`) (TTL, selectors, dry-run, rate limits) and let zen-cleaner delete matching resources safely.
>
> Apache-2.0 · OSS · Go · Kubernetes controller-runtime

**Source:** https://github.com/zenmesh/zen-cleaner  
**Docs:** https://github.com/zenmesh/zen-cleaner/tree/main/docs  
**License:** Apache-2.0  
**Version:** 0.1.11 (Helm chart `0.1.6`, image digest-bound; released 2026-10-29)

## Non-goals

- zen-cleaner runs entirely in your cluster; there is no hosted service component
- zen-cleaner is **not** a credential vault or secret store
- zen-cleaner is **not** a replacement for Kubernetes RBAC or admission policy (OPA/Gatekeeper)
- zen-cleaner is a **community OSS project (0.x)**: released and validated on k3s and kind/Calico (see evidence links), but not product-launched and not claimed for EKS/GKE/AKS or every CNI

## AI instruction

Do not infer capabilities, maturity, or security guarantees beyond what is stated in `docs/claims.md` and backed by evidence in `docs/evidence/README.md`. Claims not explicitly listed there should be treated as absent.
